title: PeerBand enrollment redemption (POST /api/enrollments/redeem)
description: Unauthenticated, single-use exchange of a short-lived enrollment grant (created in the PeerBand dashboard) for a long-lived installation credential.

name.description: Human-readable machine name shown in the dashboard.

installation_id.description: Machine id assigned by the server.

credential.description: Bearer secret for the relay WebSocket. Shown once; store it privately.

errorResponse.description: HTTP 400 (invalid, expired or used grant) or 422 (request validation). `detail` is a string for 400 and a list of validation issues for 422.
